subject: [hw] V14 start: T32 16-bit instructions
body: V14 (T32 16-bit) starting. I own gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t16.c and test_v14/**. Reading n2a32.h; implementing all 16-bit encodings incl. LDM/STM (0xC000-0xCFFF, not listed in my deliverable text but unowned by V16 which is 32-bit only). Will post exact decode masks to hw-v02 shortly.
